logic.top_level: all: pain-and-conservative-care block, then imaging, then phase rules for repeats
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate Exclusions list (sacral lateral branch blocks S1-S3, atlantoaxial C1-2, occipital nerve blocks, hardware injection) and Contraindications list of relative contraindications ('Although there are no absolute contraindications ...'). Pain source exclusions are inline: 'not sacroiliac joint pain, discogenic pain, disc herniation, or radiculitis'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Explicit phases. Initial treatment phase: up to 2 diagnostic injections, no sooner than 2 weeks apart (7 days if the prior was local-anesthetic-only block), at the same level with >=50% pain relief or functional improvement, or a second at a different level/technique if the first gave no relief. Therapeutic phase: repeat only after >=50% relief for a minimum of 2 months, continuing pain >=6, ongoing active conservative treatment. Max 4 facet injections per 12 months per region. 'Any injection performed at least two years from prior injections in the same region will be considered a new episode of care.'

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Is causing functional disability or average pain level of ≥ 6 (scale of 0 to 10)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: OR lets the numeric pain gate be bypassed by 'functional disability', which is undefined.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Failure to respond to non-operative conservative treatment* targeting the requested spinal region for a minimum of six (6) weeks in the last six (6) months unless the medical reason this treatment cannot be done is clearly documented
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Unless-clause plus three alternative definitions of failure plus an OR branch for patients with prior spinal injections ('details of engagement in ongoing ... treatment').

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Is either: By history, mainly axial or non-radicular; Is radicular due to stenosis caused by synovial cyst (confirmed on imaging)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Sub-OR nested inside an all-of under a bullet labelled 'Pain that:'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: At the same level, provided at least 50% pain relief or significant documented functional improvement is obtained OR a second diagnostic injection may be performed at a different spinal level or with a change in technique
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Two alternatives with different preconditions (success vs. no relief); reads as a branching rule, not a conjunction.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: In the diagnostic phase, a maximum of 2 procedures may be performed. Repeat diagnostic injections after prior radiofrequency neurolysis are approvable if there is a question about the pain generator, different levels are to be targeted, or if there is surgery in the same spinal region.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A restated cap with an unrelated exception clause; the final sentence applies to 1754 history, not the injection.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: A maximum of 4 facet injections may be performed in a 12-month period per spinal region (except under unusual circumstances, such as a recurrent injury)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'unusual circumstances' undefined; unclear whether diagnostic and therapeutic count together.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: RFA cannot be performed on patients who have received an intra-articular joint injection instead of diagnostic medial branch blocks.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A downstream consequence in a Note about a different procedure, inside the injection guideline.

extraction_hazards: Eight guidelines in one 102-page PDF; epidural (1750, 1751), facet (1753), RF (1754) and others have near-duplicate headings and the same Special Note text. A section splitter must key on 'Evolent_CG_17xx'.
Footnote markers '*' and '**' on 'conservative treatment' and 'HEP' point to definitions in Background pages after the criteria.
Superscript-style citation numbers in parentheses after headings, e.g. 'Facet Joint Pain (1)', 'Repeat Injections (1,6)', look like criteria values.
Add-on codes have a leading '+' in the code column; the last CPT row on page 6 is truncated ('code for primary') because the description is cut at the page break.
Each guideline repeats its own table of contents, so headings appear twice.
Checkbox glyphs for lines of business (☒) and private-use bullets.
Initial-vs-therapeutic phase structure sits as nested bullets under one heading with a NOTE about RFA after it.
Over half the pages per guideline are evidence summaries and reference lists.
interesting_structures: Phase model: initial diagnostic phase then therapeutic phase, each with its own relief and spacing thresholds.
New-episode reset: two years since last injection in the region returns the patient to initial requirements.
Same-level right/left injections within one month count as one procedure for the annual cap.
Separate authorization is needed for each day of service.
Conservative care defined as one active plus one inactive modality; HEP has a two-element documentation test.
Waivers of the conservative therapy requirement for patients with prior spinal injections in the same region.
Thresholds differ across the two sibling guidelines (diagnostic success 50% in CG 1753 vs 70% in CG 1754; RFA relief 4 months).

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Mostly all/any, but depends on injection history (phase, relief duration, counts within rolling and two-year windows), waivers inside criteria, citation numbers and footnote definitions, and a bundled PDF where the right guideline must be located first.
